title: Mobile Toolchain Probe v1
description: EPIC M1.02 of docs/plan/MOBILE-PLATFORM-ROADMAP-1.0.18.md. A factual, read-only record of what developer tool versions and executable paths actually resolve ON THIS MACHINE right now (xcodebuild, simctl, xcresulttool, and where present gradle/javac/adb). scripts/mobile_toolchain_probe.py is a sibling of scripts/mobile_project_profile.py (mobile-project-profile-v1), which answers a different question (what a PROJECT DIRECTORY'S files say about its stack). This probe never reads a project directory and never accepts a caller-supplied path or version override for any tool: every resolved_path and version comes only from shutil.which() against the real process PATH and from actually running the tool's own version flag. A tool not found, or whose invocation fails, is NO-DATA, never guessed. Only the keyword subset scripts/mobile_project_profile.py's own schema documents is used here (matching that convention): type, required, properties, enum, const, items, minItems, additionalProperties -- no $ref, this checker's enforced subset does not support it, so each tool entry is written out in full below.

schema_version.description: Which shape this record follows, so a reader never has to guess.

probed_at_revision.description: The exact git revision of the Brother checkout the probe ran from (not a project's revision -- this module never inspects a project directory). NO-DATA if this checkout is not a git repository.

tools.description: One entry per probed tool: xcodebuild, simctl, xcresulttool, gradle, javac, adb. Each entry's resolved_path and version come only from shutil.which() and the tool's own --version-style output; never from a project directory or a caller override.

resolved_path.description: shutil.which('xcrun') result (simctl is invoked as `xcrun simctl`, never a standalone binary), or NO-DATA.

version.description: First line of `xcrun simctl --version`, or NO-DATA.

resolved_path.description: shutil.which('xcrun') result (xcresulttool is invoked as `xcrun xcresulttool`), or NO-DATA.

version.description: First line of `xcrun xcresulttool version`, or NO-DATA.

resolved_path.description: shutil.which('gradle') result, or NO-DATA. Never a project's own ./gradlew wrapper -- this module never reads a project directory.

version.description: First line of `javac -version` output (stdout or stderr, whichever is non-empty), or NO-DATA.

ios_toolchain_status.description: 'complete' only if xcodebuild, simctl and xcresulttool are all status 'found'; 'none' if all three are 'no-data'; otherwise 'partial'.

android_toolchain_status.description: 'complete' only if gradle, javac and adb are all status 'found'; 'none' if all three are 'no-data'; otherwise 'partial'.
